summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Changes are additive (803 insertions, 0 deletions) and uncommitted. Nothing was executed: no tests, mypy, or imports were run, so verification was by reading only. Please run the test suite and mypy before merging. Open risks: on Python 3.6, typing.IO's abstract members (mode, name, truncate) may make _ProgressReader uninstantiable; a BufferedReader passed as BinaryIO may raise a mypy error; the return-value/type-var suppression from the spec was not added because mypy could not be run to confirm it is needed. Design choices: the byte-count column is DownloadColumn; Progress.open uses io.open internally; the module-level open implementation types mode as Any so its call to the overloaded Progress.open resolves.
